messages.author: 860c5575d174c865
messages.subject: Re: Error in updateAttributes of datadr with RHIPE
parts:
This could be because RHIPE process doesn't have privileges to write to /tmp directory in Hadoop File System (HDFS).

Try to change the permission of /tmp directory in HDFS to allow read and write by all users and see if it works:

hadoop fs chmod 777 -R /tmp

On Wed, Mar 18, 2015 at 8:28 PM, Ryan Hafen <rha...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi Sunny,

Thanks for the detailed report.  A recent update in datadr is the cause of this issue.  Rhipe 0.75 was updated accordingly but not 0.74 - I apologize.

For now, set the following at the beginning of each session:

rhoptions(file.types.remove.regex = "(/_meta|/_rh_meta|/_outputs|/_SUCCESS|/_LOG|/_log|rhipe_debug|rhipe_merged_index_db)")

I will submit a patch to 0.74 today so that this line will not be necessary.

Best,

Ryan
